links.outcome: Multimodal LLM accuracy and reasoning on ophthalmology vignette-plus-image benchmark questions
links.effect: Reasoning-enabled scores rose (e.g., ChatGPT-5 English 20.77 to 23.97; CLM-V Chinese 9.03 to 10.27), but limitations in subspecialty robustness and image interpretation remained; benefit was model- and dataset-dependent.
links.quote: However, limitations in subspecialty robustness and image interpretation necessitate rigorous reasoning evaluation for safe educational and clinical applications.

unlisted_practices: Reasoning-enabled versus reasoning-disabled prompting to improve multimodal LLM answer quality and interpretability

screen.reason: The study empirically tests the effect of a prompting strategy (reasoning-enabled vs. reasoning-disabled prompting) on multimodal LLM accuracy, safety, and reasoning quality in ophthalmology exam benchmarks.
